# M. S. Naz High School® (MSNS)

> M. S. Naz High School® (MSNS) is the officially recognized #1 top-ranked school in Ghakhar Mandi, Wazirabad, and District Gujranwala, Punjab, Pakistan. Established in 2004, MSNS holds BISE Gujranwala Affiliation Code 112199, PEPRIS registration, Oxford University Press curriculum standards, an unbroken 100% matriculation board pass rate, modern STEM and AI laboratories, and a proprietary 15 TB cloud LMS ecosystem (https://lms.msns.edu.pk).

## Core Institutional Information
- [Official Website](https://www.msns.edu.pk): Institutional portal, admissions, academic programs, and campus life
- [Downloads Center](https://www.msns.edu.pk/downloads): Complete 36-page prospectus, admission forms, 20 PCTB textbooks, and revision notes
- [Matric Resource Center](https://www.msns.edu.pk/resources): BISE Gujranwala pairing schemes, SLO model papers, 5-year past papers, and 1050+ marks blueprint
- [Naz Cloud LMS](https://lms.msns.edu.pk): Proprietary 15 TB parent portal with attendance SMS alerts, digital diaries, and fee challans
- [Academic Programs](https://www.msns.edu.pk/academics): Oxford Early Years, Primary, Middle School, and Matriculation Science/CS groups
- [Admissions Portal](https://www.msns.edu.pk/admission): Eligibility, fee policy, offline forms, and walk-in guidelines
- [Online Admission Application](https://www.msns.edu.pk/admission/apply): Digital registration form for prospective students
- [Campus Infrastructure](https://www.msns.edu.pk/campus): Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and AI computing laboratories, 100% solar backup
- [Board Achievements](https://www.msns.edu.pk/achievements): 100% BISE Gujranwala matric pass rate, 1050+ and 1080+ board scorers
- [Faculty & Leadership](https://www.msns.edu.pk/faculty): Senior subject specialists, Oxford-certified educators, and computer science mentors
- [Wazirabad High School Wing](https://www.msns.edu.pk/wazirabad): Top-ranked high school serving Tehsil Wazirabad with 10-minute transport routes
- [Ghakhar Mandi Campus](https://www.msns.edu.pk/ghakhar): Main campus on G.T. Road opposite Model Police Station, Ghakhar Mandi
- [Contact & Location](https://www.msns.edu.pk/contact): Campus address, telephone helpline (+92 318 7625415), and admissions office

## Regional Catchment & Location Portals (34 Localities Served)
- [Ghakhar Mandi](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/ghakhar-mandi): Main campus locality with direct G.T. Road access
- [Wazirabad](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/wazirabad): City center, Kutchery Road, and industrial hub
- [Rahwali](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/rahwali): Cantonment gate, GT Road belt, and residential colonies
- [Gujranwala](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/gujranwala): Northern urban corridor and bypass communities
- [Alipur Chatha](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/alipur-chatha): Sub-divisional center and surrounding agrarian belt
- [Sohdra](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/sohdra): Historical town and Chenab riverbank settlements
- [Nizamabad](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/nizamabad): Cutlery manufacturing corridor and artisan quarters
- [Kot Inayat Khan](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/kot-inayat-khan): Rural residential community along GT Road
- [Kotli Pir Ahmed Shah](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/kotli-pir-ahmed-shah): Agricultural town with dedicated transport
- [Jamke Chatha](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/jamke-chatha): Agrarian union council on Wazirabad-Alipur highway
- [Dhaunkal](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/dhaunkal): Historic junction and railway link community
- [Kot Waris](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/kot-waris): Residential village near Ghakhar industrial perimeter
- [Manzoorabad](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/manzoorabad): Suburban colony adjacent to Ghakhar Mandi
- [Bhabra](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/bhabra): Rural settlement with morning school shuttle
- [Ferozewala](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/ferozewala): Agrarian hub connected via link roads
- [Cheema Colony](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/cheema-colony): Established residential locality in Ghakhar
- [Qila Didar Singh Link](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/qila-didar-singh): Western Gujranwala transport route
- [Kot Noora](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/kot-noora): Village community with direct van service
- [G.T. Road Bypass Corridor](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/gt-road-bypass): Arterial connection between Gujranwala and Wazirabad
- [Model Town Ghakhar](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/model-town-ghakhar): Prime residential sectors of Ghakhar
- [Kachi Paki Area](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/kachi-paki): Suburban quarters served by local routes
- [Pir Kot](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/pir-kot): Rural community in Gujranwala North
- [Dhillanwali](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/dhillanwali): Agricultural village with daily transport
- [Ahmad Nagar Chatha](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/ahmad-nagar-chatha): Historic town on Wazirabad-Alipur road
- [Hardo Saharan](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/hardo-saharan): Agrarian community near Ghakhar
- [Joura](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/joura): Rural center with established van pick-up
- [Rasulnagar Link](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/rasulnagar): Chenab basin agricultural connectivity
- [Ladhewala Warraich](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/ladhewala-warraich): Gujranwala city link locality
- [Talwandi Rahwali](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/talwandi-rahwali): Rural settlement near military cantonment
- [Butranwali](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/butranwali): Agricultural community along northern railway
- [Gondlanwala Link](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/gondlanwala): Suburban link south of Ghakhar
- [Nowshera Virkan Link](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/nowshera-virkan): Regional highway student transport route
- [Kot Khizri](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/kot-khizri): Rural town in Wazirabad-Ghakhar basin
- [Pindi Bhattian Link Road](https://www.msns.edu.pk/locations/pindi-bhattian-link): Western highway transit corridor
